overview: Host Danielle Balocca interviewed City Council candidate Len Glionna about his background, campaign platform, and municipal policy views. Glionna outlined his support for building a new fire headquarters, studying high school replacement plans, adopting ward representation, and expanding mixed-use development on Mystic Avenue.

items.title: Introduction and Favorite Local Eateries
items.summary: Danielle Balocca welcomed candidate Len Glionna, who shared his local roots and favorite dining spots across Medford.

items.title: Path to Local Politics and Motivation to Run
items.summary: Glionna explained his long history with the Medford Democratic Ward and City Committee and stated he entered the race following open council seats and campaign management experience.

items.title: Campaign Priorities: Fire Department Headquarters
items.summary: Glionna identified building a new fire department headquarters as his top capital priority for the council and mayor to pursue.

items.title: Diversity and Community Experiences
items.summary: Glionna detailed his family's involvement in the Hervey Magnet School, military service, and volunteer teaching in Boston to highlight his commitment to diversity and inclusion.

items.title: Medford High School Needs and Fiscal Impact
items.summary: Glionna stated he supports funding a study to determine the logistics, site ledge, secondary access, and tax impact on residents before putting a new high school project to the voters.

items.title: Support for Charter Review and Ward Representation
items.summary: Glionna advocated for a hybrid council structure of eight ward councilors and three at-large seats to broaden civic participation and lower barriers for candidates across neighborhood lines.

items.title: Zoning and Mystic Avenue Economic Development
items.summary: Glionna recommended allowing six-story mixed-use commercial and residential developments along Mystic Avenue to expand the city's commercial tax base for capital improvements.

items.title: Bridging Medford and Closing Remarks
items.summary: Glionna reflected on acting as a bridge between longtime and newer residents, listed his past civic appointments, and made a closing pitch for voter support in the council election.
